messages:
maria: Quick check-in: finalizing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. I sketched two hero variants per page in the doc — need short, testable lines + 2 bullets each. link: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/tri_mode_hero_variants
charlie: saw the doc. Suggest we make Hosted hero explicitly promise "low variance latency" and a cost line. engineers care about predictability.
kevin: ok how about we give concrete micro-copy options? Hosted hero A: 'Fast API. Predictable cost.' Hosted hero B: 'High-throughput generation, predictable pricing.' keeps it short.
sasha: Dedicated should call out SLAs and reserved GPUs. Drafts: 'Dedicated capacity. SLA-backed throughput.' and 'Reserve GPU pools for steady production.' add a one-liner about burst capacity.
emma: Private variants: 'Private inference in your VPC' and 'Air-gapped or VPC deployments with KMS.' CTA for Private should be softer: 'Request trial' or 'Start a trial'.
maria: love those. please add 2 supporting bullets per hero: one about economics (batching/quantization) and one about controls (versioning/rollouts).
charlie: sample bullets: '- Save up to 3x per-token with smart batching and cache' and '- Pin model versions & gradual rollouts with canaries'. short and testable.
kevin: benchmark note: the 3x number is from our internal test set on convAI. we should label it "typical improvement in caching-heavy workloads" and link to benchmark PDF.
sasha: inbound routing: Hosted -> self-serve funnel (marketing trial leads), Dedicated -> SDR queue (tag=dedicated), Private -> AE (tag=enterprise). include `product_mode` hidden field in forms.
emma: email/webinar funnel: main webinar + 3 short breakouts (Dedicated ops, cost optimization, private deploy checklist). Main deck 30m, breakouts 20m each. CTA in invites should map to the mode-specific routing.
maria: social schedule proposal: Teaser (M-10), Benchmark highlight w/slide (M-4), Webinar invite (M-2), Final reminder (M-1), Launch day recap + CTA (D+0).
kevin: can we craft benchmark headline for the landing page: 'Up to 3x lower inference cost on caching workloads' and a subline 'Measured across public LLMs using batching and KV cache'.
charlie: please be careful with 'up to' claims. prefer 'Up to 3x' + small copy 'Results depend on workload; see methodology'.
sasha: UTM template for all outbound: `?utm_source=launch_social&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_content={variant}&product={mode}` use exact string.
emma: for webinar emails I'll draft 3 sequences: invite, 48-hr reminder, 1-hour reminder + replay link. each email includes mode-specific CTA.
design-bot: Noted: will produce hero art directions. For Dedicated make a simple GPU pool illustration; for Hosted use latency meter; for Private use a padlock + VPC diagram.
maria: copy experiment plan: A/B test hero lines (A vs B) across paid social + organic. measure signup rate and demo requests per mode.
kevin: small tech note for implementers: HTML form hidden input example: `<input type="hidden" name="product_mode" value="{hosted|dedicated|private}">` parse on submission and route accordingly.
charlie: FAQ microcopy items to add under each page: KMS/HSM: 'We integrate with customer KMS and HSM for key control.' Data residency: 'Private deployments support on-prem / regional hosting.' SLA: 'Dedicated includes Xms p95 target and uptime SLA.' keep them < 15 words.
sasha: action items: Maria iterate and upload final variants by Tue EOD; Kevin finalize benchmark slide + PDF link by Mon EOD; Emma draft webinar emails by Wed; Charlie add FAQ one-liners by Tue; Design create hero art by Wed.
maria: tagging this thread for copy freeze planning. who can set the freeze window?
design-bot: Suggest freeze window: 2026-04-07 08:00 UTC -> 2026-04-09 23:59 UTC for final merge.
emma: I'll align with comms on social creatives schedule and add UTM checks in the calendar invite.
kevin: one more thought: keep the primary CTA label consistent visually across pages even if text differs. Design to match primary button style for all three.
maria: great. I'll post updated doc when variants are in and mark comments resolved. thanks team. :rocket:
